відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"The blazer carries the office, and the coat, scarf and beanie are there for your 20-minute walk through snow and deep frost. The boots keep your feet steady on the way. The wide trousers are the only volume in the outfit, so everything above them stays fitted. The blazer's shaped waist gives the outfit its anchor, and the long coat keeps one clean vertical line. The red scarf at your neck and the rust beanie bring colour near your face against all the grey. I chose the coat even though salty slush can wear it down faster: its length suits a long frosty walk, and a quick wipe of the hem when you arrive deals with the slush.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Tuck the sweater into the trousers under the blazer, so only the blazer ends at the hips and the waist shows.\",\"Wear the scarf at your neck over the coat collar, so its red sits next to your face.\",\"When you get to the office, wipe the coat's hem to clear off any salt.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#6·30\",\"what\":\"sweater\"},{\"n\":\"#411·37\",\"what\":\"blazer\"},{\"n\":\"#88·08\",\"what\":\"trousers\"},{\"n\":\"#57·37\",\"what\":\"coat\"},{\"n\":\"#388·09\",\"what\":\"scarf\"},{\"n\":\"#494·30\",\"what\":\"beanie\"},{\"n\":\"#392·11\",\"what\":\"boots\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#57·37\",\"text\":\"The long coat suits a business day and keeps your outline in one clean vertical line on a frosty walk to work.\"},{\"n\":\"#6·30\",\"text\":\"The sweater is a quiet, neat layer for an office day, and its trim finish keeps the top half of your outfit slim next to the wide trousers.\"},{\"n\":\"#411·37\",\"text\":\"The blazer gives you a business look for work, and its shaped waist is the anchor that keeps the wide trousers from hiding your figure.\"},{\"n\":\"#88·08\",\"text\":\"The wide trousers give you a long, easy line for the office and are the one voluminous piece of the outfit.\"},{\"n\":\"#392·11\",\"text\":\"The tall boots with a solid sole suit a 20-minute walk in snow and still look right for work.\"},{\"n\":\"#295·45\",\"text\":\"The bag holds what you need for your office day and your walk there.\"},{\"n\":\"#388·09\",\"text\":\"The scarf brings a warm red to your neck, near your face, and makes a lively accent on a deep-frost
